text: The emails Jenny sends post every weekly 1:1 session, mostly in the final year of college apps and essays as its intense, process, timeline oriented.. to both student and parents in a concise manner with summary/ key highlights or what was done in the session, key action items and whats next + next meeting schedule.. The weekly detailed execution collaboration document actually has more details and its mainly a subset of that + other important items the coach wants to bring to parents attention.. Parents are busy and actually don’t read docs, so email is a good channel IvyLevel <> Jenny and Huda 12/03/2024 Jenny Duan <jennyduan@ivymentors.co> Tue, Dec 3, 2024, 8:24 PM to huda, Siraj, Mary, me Hi Huda, Great work submitting your MIT application! Up next: UPenn and CMU!
